translations.web: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
translations.bsb: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and joy may end in sorrow.
translations.kjv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
